title: Wirelang-Spec v0.4.4 Promotion Pre-Readiness Snapshot (Tag-77)
description: Audit-only aggregate snapshot of the Tag-63..Tag-72 substrate trilogy for the v0.4.4 Reserve-Item promotion lane. Aggregates per-RES-Dn substrate-pinning evidence + HD-1/HD-2/HD-3 substrate-stub presence + Pre-Mortem (Tag-67) + Pre-Mortem-Coverage (Tag-68) anchors to a Promotion-Pre-Readiness-Score per item. The score is doc-form-only: it MUST NOT be interpreted as a promotion authorisation, an AR-authorisation request, or a draft-ADR. The score is a Reza-hand-readable status snapshot under audit-only posture; flipping any RES-Dn item from indefinite-deferral to active-candidate remains a CEO-Triage / AR-authorisation step under ADR-0023a + ADR-0023b. The Tag-77 snapshot is the Schluss-Stein of the v0.4.4 substrate-trilogy: Tag-63 baseline + Tag-64 coverage + Tag-65 sequencing + Tag-66 OTS-probes + Tag-67 pre-mortem + Tag-68 pre-mortem-coverage + Tag-69 deep-dive + Tag-70 HD-1 + Tag-71 HD-2 + Tag-72 HD-3. See docs/operations/wirelang-spec-v0-4-4-promotion-sequencing.md §8.

score_dimensions.purpose: RES-Dn normative-shape text exists in v0.4.4-draft.md (Tag-63 baseline) AND sample block exists (Tag-64 coverage extension).
RES-Dn carries an OTS-probe-coverage row in the Tag-66 catalogue (audit-only-stub, no live OTS call).
RES-Dn is named in at least one Tag-67 pre-mortem failure-mode (A/B/C/D family) AND covered by the Tag-68 pre-mortem-coverage test-suite.

If the item hard-depends on a substrate axis (HD-1 OTS, HD-2 Peer-Roster, HD-3 Audit-Coverage), the corresponding Tag-70/71/72 substrate-stub is present and audit-only-clean. Items without a hard-dep score this dimension trivially as satisfied.

CEO-Triage has authorised promotion of this RES-Dn item. Default: false (indefinite-deferral). This dimension is FROZEN-FALSE in the Tag-77 audit-only snapshot; it can only be flipped to true outside the Sandbox boundary via ADR-0023a + ADR-0023b.

scoring_methodology.score_5_meaning: All five dimensions satisfied; RES-Dn could theoretically promote under a fresh CEO-Triage PR. However: ceo-triage-authorisation is FROZEN-FALSE in Tag-77, so the score-5 ceiling is unreachable from Sandbox-Hand.
scoring_methodology.score_4_meaning: Substrate complete (Tag-63..Tag-72) but CEO-Triage authorisation outstanding. This is the natural ceiling from Sandbox-Hand: the four substrate dimensions are claude-dev-reachable, the fifth is Operator/AR-Hand.
scoring_methodology.score_lt_4_meaning: Substrate gap. The snapshot enumerates the missing dimension(s) per item; the gap MUST close before any promotion PR is opened.

what_this_snapshot_is_not: Not a draft-ADR (any ceo-triage flip requires a fresh per-item ADR-class entry per Tag-65 §5.1 A5).
Not a Pin-Pack 0.5.1 edit (Pin-Pack remains Selin/Tomas axis per Tag-65 §7.2).
Not a NATS-KV schema default change (sandbox-boundary recital).
Not an OTS-anchor activation (Tag-60 stub remains audit-only until ADR-0023a authorisation).
Not an indefinite-deferral lifting (default remains indefinite-deferral for all five items).
